verdict.rationale: llama.cpp is self-hosted local software by nature. First-party docs provide multiple deployment paths: build from source, pre-built release binaries, Docker, Winget, and a `llama serve` server with a built-in web UI. Many independent hands-on reports confirm users running it on their own Macs, desktop CPUs and GPUs, with one calling it 'very nice for something self-hosted.'
